prompt: What does the 'static' keyword mean in: public static void main(String[] args)?
choices: main() can be called without instantiating the class
main() is automatically called when any class is compiled
main() runs on a separate thread
explanation: static means the JVM can call main() on the class itself, without creating an instance first. That's necessary because no object exists yet when the program starts. args contains the command-line arguments passed to the program.
